question: What range of objects do the emanated powers encompass within consciousness?
premises: Powers are emanated whose operations extend from self-coemergent meanings down to the earth.
These operations occur within the play of consciousness.
They encompass corresponding objects within their own self-nature.
inference: The emanated powers span the full range of objects, from subtle self-arising meanings to gross earth, all within consciousness.
plain_english: The powers are emanated with operations ranging from meanings that arise with the self down to the earth, encompassing all those objects within the play of consciousness in their own self.
